news.title: Topvrouw bunq: 'de oplossing is vaak helemaal geen AI' Wie bij bunq met AI experimenteert, komt vaak uit bij een oplossing zonder AI. Dat zegt chief strategy officer Bianca Zwart van bunq. Elke vrijdag krijgt iedereen bij de bank de kans om met AI te experime

summary: bunq is dutch mobile bank and neobank, founded in 2012. Type: startup / scale-up. Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 5 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about growth or hiring; 2 about legal trouble, strikes or bankruptcy.

insights.one_liner: Amsterdam mobile bank (founded 2012) with English-only jobs and IND sponsorship; growing fast but under scrutiny over its founder's style.

culture.text: Every Friday, everyone at the bank gets time to experiment with AI, says chief strategy officer Bianca Zwart.
A new biography by investigative journalists paints founder Ali Niknam as focused on efficiency over empathy.
Current roles are mostly risk and compliance (3 of 5), all in Amsterdam.

open.text: bunq B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
All 5 of its jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers.

growth.text: Deposits hit €10 billion as it launched flexible credit limits of up to €5,000.

worth_knowing.text: US regulator OCC rejected bunq's application for an American banking licence.
NRC reported that Niknam used bullying tactics to try to beat competitor ING.
bunq has been told to restore closed private accounts.
